# Changelog

All notable changes to the Deft framework will be documented in this file.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.0.0/),
and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

## [Unreleased]

### Added
- Added — article-review Step 6.5 process-only critic pass before filing, with Step 5 mechanism inventory and Critic verdict section on filed issues. Refs #5694.
- Added — Prefer-A Recut-2 for `feedback:file`: complete open inventory dedup, closed retained-count window (500) with disposition tokens, open-match evidence comment (`commented-open-duplicate`), and `--on-closed=comment|create-anyway` without reopen. Refs #5099.
- Added — Helpers for reviewing a brief without creating a GitHub issue. These support file-based critic results, retained review records, and returning the accepted remedy to the same brief. Refs #5486.
### Changed
- Changed — Activate Prefer-A Bound running briefs for #5099 and #1178 on master (proceed cohort add; productPullRequest unset). Refs #5099 #1178.
- Changed — Activate Prefer-A Bound running brief for #5694 on master (proceed cohort add; productPullRequest unset). Refs #5694.
- Changed — Activate Prefer-A Bound running briefs for #5690 and #5486 on master (proceed cohort; productPullRequest unset). Refs #5690 #5486.

### Fixed
- Fixed — Land tracked completion records for #5690 (PR #5704) and #5694 (PR #5706). Refs #5690 #5694.
- **CLI `verify:review-monitor --explicit-finish` honors mint-gate refusal (#5690).** Pass `--mint-gate-blocked` / mint-marker `--reason` into `writeMergePathExplicitFinishAttestation` so cohort `halted-explicit` cannot mask an unarmed product PR. Raise `agentsMdBudget.absoluteMaxBytes` 28100→28400 for the #5318/#5690 agents-entry pointer; sync review-cycle skills pack projection. Tracking #5690.
- **Approach 1 mint-gate exit no longer leaves the product PR merge-path unarmed (#5690).** Keep or same-turn re-arm product `--merge-path-arm --live-wait` across attended mint; mint-gate BLOCKED is non-option-C; CLEAN-before-mint keeps the post-CLEAN closer; #5318 inventory adds mint-PR-open / mint-PR-merge triggers. Tracking #5690. Refs #4882 #5219 #5318.

### Fixed
- **`triage:accept` now shows whether a brief was created, reused, or refused (#4962).** It reuses a single owning brief for the same issue and repository. When several briefs own the issue, or the owning brief is completed or cancelled, it refuses without creating another brief. Tracking #4962.
- **SessionStart publishes applying-host before Shell PreToolUse (#5676).** Worktree `.deft/applying-host.json` records provider, raw id, `applyingHostSessionId`, and `claimed_at`. Non-matching multi-host deposits soft-pass when the command names that id; leftover `GROK_SESSION_ID` alone does not remap native Cursor to `host:claude` (genuine `GROK_HOOK_EVENT` Claude→grok preserved). Read-only `session:start` may bootstrap the record; mutation/rearm republishes as reinforcement. UUID residuals stay under #5544. Tracking #5676 / Refs #5544 #4708 #4660.
- **Pre-push three-axis guidance no longer requires remote PR head match (#4888).** Local merge-chokepoint `deft check`/`task check` validates before push; `evaluateNonCascadeCandidateGreen` SHA-pair attestation applies after push when local HEAD matches the live remote PR head (and on conflict-resolve/behind-rebase). Tracking #4888.
- **Combined cascade + candidate-validation limbs no longer skip attestation (#4888).** When both `cascadeMode` and `requireCandidateValidation` are set, cascade absolute refusal still runs first, then candidate validation must pass. Cascade-only callers stay cascade-only. Tracking #4888.
- **Issue #3906 now has a tracked completion record.** The record links to the fix delivered in #5649, so the issue can close without losing its scope history. Tracking #3906.
- **Issue #3907 now has a tracked completion record.** The record links to the fix delivered in #5651, so the issue can close without losing its scope history. Tracking #3907.
- **Issue #3908 now has a tracked completion record.** The record links to the fix delivered in #5653, so the issue can close without losing its scope history. Tracking #3908.
- **Grok missing `deft-hook` no longer fails open (#5656).** Deposit a PreToolUse shell wrapper that denies when `deft-hook` is missing or non-decision; require positive governing story allow for Write/implement spawn; add prospective staged scope-cover evaluation; name silent gate loss for non-fail-closed hosts. Staged-path listing returns Result (no throw) so intent-constraint stays free of operational hard facts. Prospective cover also includes typechanges and rename sources, and does not treat letters inside attached `-m`/`-F` values as index-mutating flags. Tracking #5656.
- **Export-spec keeps string Requirements and AcceptanceCriteria with stable order (#4871).** Full-spec export falls back to PROJECT-DEFINITION only when those keys are missing (spec wins on conflict). Plan-item `AcceptanceCriteria` renders as bullets (`Acceptance` stays an alias). TechStack remains on the Wave 0 §5 exclude list. Tracking #4871.
- **Prevent stale ordered-plan changes (#3907).** Competing commands in the same worktree can no longer overwrite or clear a plan using an outdated generation. Clearing and recreating a plan keeps older commands from changing its replacement. Persist failures are retryable. CLI `set`, `advance`, and `clear` require `--expected-generation`. Tracking #3907.
- **Competing sessions cannot change worktree files before claiming occupancy (#3906).** Cold, re-arm, and `session:ready` persist the worktree lease before any linked-deposit copy. Failed setup rolls back only this invocation's claim. Tracking #3906.
- **A session re-checks occupancy before writing ritual (#3906).** A steal during ceremony no longer lets the first session overwrite the new owner's ritual. Tracking #3906.
- **Competing scope moves preserve the winning brief (#3908).** When two processes move the same scope, the losing attempt no longer overwrites or removes the winner's destination. Spec-drift lock-refuse unlinks dest this process created so a retry is not blocked. Dest symlink/containment refusals stay returned-failure (no throw). Tracking #3908.

## [0.125.2] - 2026-10-15

> Fail-closed PreToolUse dest harvest (#5366), Codex critic workdir (#4998), installer tarball SHA pin (#5627), completed-write-guard (#5602), auto-discover delivery evidence (#3583).

### Fixed

- **Recognize Codex critic launch directories (#4998).** Hooks can allow a Claude critic to launch in a prepared linked worktree when Codex supplies its working directory, even if the session stays in the parent checkout. Invalid or conflicting directory fields remain blocked. Live Codex 0.162 still omits that directory from hook input, so those launches remain blocked. Grok critic launches that name a prepared dest with `--cwd` still succeed when nested workdir is the parent checkout. Tracking #4998.
- **`verify:scope-provenance` no longer tells operators to pass `--enforce` to fail closed (#5057).** Soft findings are advisory intent-pin drift on a brief with no intent pin. `--enforce` stays parsed for compatibility, prints that it has no effect after #4956 / #5002, and does not change the exit code. Tracking #5057.
- **PreToolUse dest harvest miss no longer fail-opens write-shaped MCP (#5366).** Harvest `uri`/`file`; empty-harvest fail-closes write-shaped effective names (ApplyPatch class); unwrap `use_tool`/`CallMcpTool` shell inners with an effective argument view into Shell/UAT; decode local `file:` URIs and refuse unsupported schemes; active write fence denies empty/unclassified targets. Tracking #5366.
- **Issue #5366 now has a tracked completion record.** The record links to the fix delivered in #5639, so the issue can close without losing its scope history. Tracking #5366.
- **`triage:show` fails closed on quarantine hard-fail (#5367).** Refuse with exit 1 + stderr notice when scan meta hard-fails, scanned `content.md` is missing, or scan status is unknown — never re-emit `raw.json` into default/operator briefs. Passed path reads scanned content, strips the render header, and omits quarantined fence regions from summary/AC. Keep-outs: #5369, #5370, #5371, #5623. Tracking #5367.
- **Issue #5367 now has a tracked completion record.** The record links to the fix delivered in #5636, so the issue can close without losing its scope history. Tracking #5367.
- **Pin + verify the Go installer framework tarball before extract (#5627 / install-deposit-03).** `downloadAndExtractCore` checks SHA-256 of `GET .../tarball/<pinnedTag>` against a hard-coded pin (reuse `verifyFileSHA256`) and fails closed before extract/deposit/swap so `WriteConsumerGitHooks` never wires hooks from an unverified payload. Non-pinned refs refuse; omitting `--branch` defaults to the pin and does not inherit release ldflags `defaultBranch`/`github.ref_name`. Trust-artifact class is the GitHub source-tarball digest (pin-bump when GitHub regenerates under the same tag). Frozen already-shipped installer binaries are not retroactively fixed — `npx @deftai/directive init` remains the upgrade path for those hosts. Tracking #5627.
- **Issue #5627 now has a tracked completion record.** The record links to the fix delivered in #5634, so the issue can close without losing its scope history. Tracking #5627.
- **Design-critique brief Stop 1 `pain:` envelope field (#4514).** Copyable brief lists closed forms (`pain: P1` / `pain: P1, P2` / `pain:` then `- P1`) for the triage write-back only, not critic comments; content-contract locks `` `pain:` `` and skill `Pain coverage`. Tracking #4514.
- **Issue #4514 now has a tracked completion record.** The record links to the fix delivered in #5630, so the issue can close without losing its scope history. Tracking #4514.
- **`spec:render` keeps multiline phase How/Why/What newlines (#5042).** Object narrative prose is pass-through with `itemHandlerIndent` on nonblank lines (not `oneLine`), so narrative-carried overview bullets stay a Markdown list. #4511 heading taxonomy unchanged. Tracking #5042.
- **Issue #5042 now has a tracked completion record.** The record links to the fix delivered in #5625, so the issue can close without losing its scope history. Tracking #5042.
- **Keep orientation and session-bind state local (#3911).** Canonical TS/Go ignore baselines cover .deft/orientation-state.json, .deft/session-bind.json, and .deft/session-binds/; init/update heals those lines and exact-path index-only untracks already-indexed copies without deleting local files (staged-conflict refuse). Shared `git rm --cached` port honors ADR-004 port-record mode so `directive update --dry-run` / dest planning never stages those deletions. Freshness docs state deposit/toolchain-only, not lifecycle authority. Tracking #3911.
- **Issue #3911 now has a tracked completion record.** The record links to the fix delivered in #5624, so the issue can close without losing its scope history. Tracking #3911.
- Leftover-complete closer trail for #4878 (after Tracking product #5604).

### Fixed

- **`swarm:routing-set` records a model decision from a linked worktree (#3827).** Containment uses the same main-checkout root as the resolved `.deft/routing.local.json`, so the command no longer refuses its own target. Tracking #3827.
- **Issue #3827 now has a tracked completion record.** The record links to the fix delivered in #5619, so the issue can close without losing its scope history. Tracking #3827.
- **Class-checks exclude lifecycle xBRIEF records from pipeline-path classification (#5159).** `pathLooksLikePipeline` returns false when `isLifecycleArtifactPath` is true. Real pipeline configs still fail class 2/3.
- **Issue #5159 now has a tracked completion record.** The record links to the fix delivered in #5618, so the issue can close without losing its scope history. Tracking #5159.
- **`scope:complete` now finds delivery evidence automatically (#3583).** You can omit `--pr` and `--merge-commit` when the recorded product PR or a single matching closing PR proves delivery. Explicit flags still override automatic discovery, and completion refuses missing, ambiguous, or incomplete evidence. Tracking #3583.
- **Finish #5602 leftover-complete after product #5610.** Lands the completed Prefer-A leftover-complete write-guard brief with delivery provenance so the issue can close and scope records stay tracked. Tracking #5602.
- **Finish #4878 leftover-complete after product #5604.** Lands the completed acceptance-evidence brief with delivery provenance so operators can close the issue and keep scope records tracked. Tracking #4878.
- **Finish #3583 leftover-complete after product #5613.** Lands the completed auto-discover delivery-evidence brief with delivery provenance so the issue can close and scope records stay tracked. Tracking #3583.
- **Land the #4878 active scope brief after product #5604.** Carrier lands the dest-local active xBRIEF onto delivery so leftover-complete / swarm:finalize-cohort can run. Tracking #4878.
- **scope:complete on a stale active path names the completed/cancelled sibling (#4881).** When the target file is missing, complete probes sibling lifecycle folders for the same basename and returns already-completed (with #3679 restamp path) or already-cancelled instead of File not found; wrong basenames stay File not found; a real completed/ path still restamps. Tracking #4881.
- **Acceptance-evidence refusals name `plan.items[N]` and ignore `acceptance.clauses` (#4878).** Gate walk paths and completion listings use the qualified object path `plan.items[N]` (and nested `plan.items[N].subItems[M]` / `plan.items[N].items[M]`). Refusal trailer tells operators to stamp evidence/disposition on that plan item; the gate does not read evidence from `plan.acceptance.clauses[]`. `verify:pr-closeout-attestable` indexes the same `plan.items` prefix so closing-PR refusal guidance keeps axis/merge instructions. Tracking #4878.

## [0.120.0] - 2026-10-04

> Named Source/Confidence and verified TrustLevel (#479), shipped-closed tip discovery (#3495), merge-time closeout (#3875), requirement restamp (#3920), plus authz/occupancy and related fixes.

### Added
- Added — article-review Step 6.5 process-only critic pass before filing, with Step 5 mechanism inventory and Critic verdict section on filed issues. Refs #5694.
- Added — Prefer-A Recut-2 for `feedback:file`: complete open inventory dedup, closed retained-count window (500) with disposition tokens, open-match evidence comment (`commented-open-duplicate`), and `--on-closed=comment|create-anyway` without reopen. Refs #5099.
- Added — Helpers for reviewing a brief without creating a GitHub issue. These support file-based critic results, retained review records, and returning the accepted remedy to the same brief. Refs #5486.
### Changed

### Fixed

- **Pre-PR HMAC chmod-fail removes an unusable own-create secret; EXISTS race does not delete (#4912).** Exclusive create still loads a 0600 winner on EXISTS/EEXIST. chmod failure after this process created the secret retries, then containedRemove of leftover 0644 so the next start can create. A 0644 EXISTS winner is not loaded and is not deleted. `startControllerRun` and `deft pre-pr:run` report put deny instead of started. Tracking #4912.
- **Pre-PR HMAC secret create race and unreadable reviewed-file hash (#4912).** Concurrent file-backed stores load the winner secret when exclusive create hits EXISTS; `computeControllerObservedHash` returns null for directories and unreadable paths. Tracking #4912.
- **Pre-PR controller residual (#4912).** CLI default store survives process exit; `--observe-command` requires `--exit-code`; semantic hashes must match independently hashed reviewed-file contents for every semantic phase; file-backed records are HMAC-wrapped; newest run wins PR-node lookup and a presented run id beats an older node match; live evaluate uses current approved criteria. PR node id and body hash bind the live check; required phases must complete in PRE_PR_PHASES order. Tracking #4912.
- **Incomplete failed x-claims still need `invalidates`; empty Verifier/VerifiedAt keys require Source (#479).** Skip the invalidates edge only when both `ruledOutReason` and `evidenceRefs` are non-empty. Evidence-only narratives stay a mission-style exception. Tracking #479.
- **`verify:changelog-unreleased` fails when the Unreleased `- ` set is unchanged versus merge-base (#633).** Shares `changelog-check --against-merge-base` (default off for `task change:changelog:check`). Restores N/A-with-reason on detector-named PR checklist items. Tracking #633.
- **Release Step 5 coverage-final diagnostic + skip-ci unpaid ledger (#5239).** Step 5 coverage decline messaging no longer depends on parent `DEFT_RELEASE_PREFLIGHT`. Production `--allow-skip-ci=#N` refuses unpaid citations (open/unknown issue or prior CHANGELOG spend) unless `--allow-unpaid-skip-ci=#N` matches. Hang named-cause treats last-file as cursor only. Spend record for the v0.119.13 cut: `--allow-skip-ci=5239`. Tracking #5239.
- **Closeout no-xbrief probe fails closed on missing repo, PR-head lookup, or HEAD verify errors (#3875).** A missing linked worktree still skips cleanly; an unverified slug/forge/HEAD read no longer returns success. Hermetic review suites opt out of closeout explicitly. Tracking #3875.
- **Completed-write guard validates disposition provenance; item-status default-open inverted (#3819).** Completed xBRIEF writes require typed human-origin dispositions; malformed or missing status no longer skips provenance checks. Tracking #3819.
- **Consumer upgrade deposit: root `.deft-version` allowlist, binary-safe gitattributes, lock follow-through (#5245).** Root marker is installer-managed; delete-repair runs only when lifecycle root resolves (legacy trees keep root marker and get a migrate hint). `.deft/core/** text=auto eol=lf` replaces forced `text eol=lf` so vendored PNGs keep bytes. pnpm/npm lock checks use full-key freeze-except-additions (necessary new transitives allowed; yarn stays fully frozen). Dirty-escape `--json` emits classified stage sets. Tracking #5245.
- **Cold `session_start` JSONL carries a closed `trigger`; steal refuses to mint a writer id the shell does not hold (#3921).** One cold emit per host session (thin/compact and verbose); extra cold lines need a documented trigger. Compact and re-arm markers apply only when the prior ritual session id matches the admitted session; a leftover compact after lease expiry is `cold` for a new claimant. Closes #3921.
- **`spec:render` no longer treats bare `--` as the spec path (#548).** `parseIncludeScopesFlag` ignores the POSIX end-of-options token without latching (same shape as #5251 roadmap-render). Tracking #548.
- **Requirement-source restamp residuals (#3920).** Promote and activate keep the stamp; completion keeps autofix results; missing or unreadable sources refuse; intake does not invent requirement files or stamp the brief path across lifecycle moves. Tracking #3920.
- **Occupancy product-write refuse keeps Prefer-A mutation marker; Overview CAS refuses concurrent AGENTS.md edits (#4544).** Scaffold-header refuse no longer deletes the completion stamp (later verify stays fail-closed). Remediation re-reads AGENTS.md at write time and refuses when the snapshot drifted. Tracking #4544.
- **First-ship AGENTS header completion no longer depends on remembering to stamp the mutation marker or run check (#4544).** After product work, the exact scaffold edit-me header is remediating via confirmed Overview when available, or refused with a clear remedy when it is not. Process-only and already-custom headers stay legal. Tracking #4544.
- **`roadmap:render` no longer treats bare `--` as an output path (#5251).** Help and unknown-flag handling match sibling render CLIs; review-cycle skill guidance names which verbs reject vs ignore bare `--`. Usage lists the `--project-root` and pendingDir forms separately; dash-leading paths use `./name` (no end-of-options latch). Tracking #5251.
- **Oracle-integrity detector no longer treats `independent_rederivation` on the run-summary as a security waiver (#3925).** Fail→method-change→pass stays unresolved even when that boolean is true on the agent-writable stream. Recovery for poisoned history remains a new session or truncate-delete. Same-stream attested_by / hashes / seq-gap stay out. Closes #3925. Refs #3322.
- **Authz CLI exits cleanly when grant or UAT writes are refused (#4233).** Tracking #4233.
- **Authz refuses grant and pin changes while UAT is active (#4233).** Ending UAT without the human-presence suspend path is refused; spending a single-use grant still works. Empty pins activate no grants under UAT. Tracking #4233.
- **Authz store writes stay consistent when interrupted or a lock holder dies (#4233).** Failed writes return a clear refusal; publishing a release reports when a single-use approval could not be spent after the release went public. Tracking #4233.
- **Host capability stamp freshness checks stay stable across clock skew (#5229).** Tracking #5229.
- **Repeat panel dispatch no longer trusts a bad handback claim (#3979).** A wrong or missing comment id does not reuse an earlier matching post; failed panel checks also block path-1 auto-stamp. Tracking #3979.
- **`verify:consumer-check-contract` reachability: do not let `- env:`/`- with:` nested maps steal step-field indent (#4015).** Gate step `if:` / `run:` / `continue-on-error` after a leading env/with block stay visible so skippable or soft-fail gates cannot read clean. Tracking #4015.
- `pr:watch` and merge-readiness treat unresolved Greptile inline P0/P1 on the current head as blocking, including when the rolling summary still names an older commit; a thin REST fallback without resolution state does not force that match when the summary is stale (#3944).

> Residual re-ingest (#5177), first-ship PD/AGENTS gates (#5176/#4544), Windows Step 5 cheapen (#5140), and Fresh-clone completed-land (#4714).

### Added
- Added — article-review Step 6.5 process-only critic pass before filing, with Step 5 mechanism inventory and Critic verdict section on filed issues. Refs #5694.
- Added — Prefer-A Recut-2 for `feedback:file`: complete open inventory dedup, closed retained-count window (500) with disposition tokens, open-match evidence comment (`commented-open-duplicate`), and `--on-closed=comment|create-anyway` without reopen. Refs #5099.
- Added — Helpers for reviewing a brief without creating a GitHub issue. These support file-based critic results, retained review records, and returning the accepted remedy to the same brief. Refs #5486.
### Changed

- **process(swarm,review): bind multi-hour babysit via envelope + declared budgets (#3984).** No parent-turn-shape detector on this number. Approach 1 / review-monitor dispatch is the cheaper ownership path vs parent-as-leaf implement; cheaper one-liner requires live `pr:watch` + `verify:review-monitor --merge-path-arm --live-wait` (lease-only yield stays unarmed, #4882). `pr:watch` resolves declared wait via `--max-wait-minutes` / `DEFT_PR_WATCH_MAX_WAIT_MINUTES` (`resolveDeclaredWaitBudget`); rejects budgets whose seconds conversion is non-finite; `--help` still prints when env budget is invalid. #3153 wall-clock row fires only when a budget is declared (30m default stays a poll cap). agentsMdBudget managedMaxLines 189→190 / absoluteMaxBytes 22886→23600 for the agents-entry pin. #5219 stays separate. Tracking #3984.
- **Windows Step 5 cold-worktree sequencing + unit git-tail cheapen (#5140).** Refresh committed Vitest file durations from a retained Step 5 tee; keep prior ≥30s timings the incomplete tee omitted; share-plus-reset the durable-effect unit git tail; keep unit/spawn-heavy overlapping (no `groupOrder` serial drain). Host probe and fixture notes: `docs/RELEASING.md`. Keep 60m hang detector and #5026 no-coverage host lane; first ship tracks reliable sub-60m without `--skip-ci`. Refs #5022, #5026, #5027, #5028, #4567. Tracking #5140.

### Fixed

- **Scope membership Path B no longer hard-requires a human mint when a concrete merge-base brief already matches (#5192).** Continuity-resolved mint still wins (stale `xbriefRelPath` ok; same-path `plan.id` relabel refuses); missing mint uses concrete base `file_scope` precommitment with source-root allowance; tests/fixtures stay refused without allowlist match; missing-mint remediation is split or land a widened concrete brief. Tracking #5192.
- **Completed moves and plan.id basename deletes stay inside membership/fence (#5192 residual).** Pinned presentation-coverage includes changed lifecycle briefs and a full merge-base lifecycle census; plan.id continuity exempts only the resolved path pair (no basename fan-out). Tracking #5192.
- **no-plan.id completed moves keep merge-base precommitment and prefer active over pending (#5192 residual).** Membership and the production fence share pre-move same-basename resolution (active before pending); a same-basename candidate must be absent from HEAD so an unrelated live brief cannot supply scope; basename-keyed mints whose planId mismatches the basename key stay invalid. Tracking #5192.
- **Entry-path babysit no longer fail-opens as Tier 3 when spawn_subagent exists (#5229).** Sticky lease is consulted before READY (including Approach 3); register writes a durable host→CLI capability stamp (age-bound; session-bound only with explicit parent session); bare / flag-shaped `--monitor-agent-id` is refused at `pr:watch` when Tier 1 is provable; Approach 1 stays the cheapest admitted babysit. Host stamp schema version uses `Number.parseInt` so merge-gate `verify:intent-constraint` stays free without a human mint. Keeps #3984 / #4529 implement / shipped #5219 join untouched. Tracking #5229.
- **External writes to the inventoried authz store are denied (#4709).** Write, Edit, and Shell cannot plant grant files on the inactive path. Closes #4709.
- **Shell store writes resolve against the named payload project (#4709 residual).** Tracking #4709.
- **Denied store writes do not spend a single-use grant (#4709 residual).** Tracking #4709.
- **Parent-shell `pr:watch` no longer arms Approach 1 merge-path on `spawn_subagent` hosts (#5219).** `verify:review-monitor --merge-path-arm --live-wait` joins the sticky lease `monitor_agent_id` to wait heartbeat `parent_id`; bare `parent_id=pr-watch` and CLI-only `--monitor-agent-id` impersonation do not. Post-CLEAN `pr-wait-mergeable` arms only with a child-bound CLEAN attestation for the live PR HEAD (parent one-shot does not write attestation; stale caller `--head-sha` cannot override a newer tip). Child stamps via spawn-injected `DEFT_MONITOR_AGENT_ID` (or CLI matching `GROK_SESSION_ID`); babysitter one-liner starts watch before parent verify. Raise `agentsMdBudget.absoluteMaxBytes` through 24200 for Envelope SLA + #3984/#5219 prose. Recurrence of #4821; keeps #3984 out. Tracking #5219.

Hatch, hotspots, and forward-coverage consume the produced report; a vitest assertion failure cannot reach `BRANCH_HAIRLINE` / `pass_with_debt`. Keep `COVERAGE_GOAL` 85. Leaves #3512 open. Tracking #4244.
- **Step 5 missing-report stderr only when the suite was expected to write coverage (#4244).** Named decline no longer says "missing after suite" for earlier-gate fails or the #5026 no-coverage host lane. Renew evaluator-surface disclosure for `vitest.config.ts`. Tracking #4244.
- **WSL ownership residual Prefer-B (#1617).** `ownership:doctor` / `ownership:fix` / `verify:ownership` use house `:engine:invoke` task calls only (runtime-verb allowlist; no `_ts-build` as root). Removes `ownership-ensure-cli` / `ownership-run` shims and the root temp-worktree bootstrap. Tracking #1617.

- **fix(swarm): retained-brief unexpected write errors return `ok:false` (#4714).** After `containedWrite` in `materializeRetainedBrief`, non-`ContainedWriteError` failures are returned instead of rethrown so `verify:intent-constraint` stays free. Tracking #4714.
- **fix(swarm): retained-brief materialize uses `containedWrite` (#4714).** `materializeRetainedBrief` no longer raw-`writeFileSync`s into the lifecycle checkout; failures return `ok:false`. Tracking #4714.
- **fix(swarm): reviewed-brief recovery walks `origin/<deliveryBranch>` (#4714).** History fallback no longer uses remote default `origin/HEAD`, so retained bytes cannot match the wrong branch; Fresh-clone completed-land rule is mirrored into `agents-entry`. Tracking #4714.

Unreadable lifecycle folders or unparsed recognized-suffix files cannot certify either empty claim. Tracking #4756.

Tracking #4879.

Run `deft migrate:clause-ids` to rewrite cancelled/completed corpus to `clause.N`. Brief-named links and lifecycle-folder directory symlinks that validate visits, plus `clause:N`/`clause.N` collisions, are conflicts. Empty `xbrief/` falls back to leftover `vbrief/`; unrelated duplicate ids and non-brief file or directory symlinks do not block the hop. Residual of #4707. Closes #5011.
- **fix(update): same-root AGENTS render + sha stamp on deposit (#5013).** `writeAgentsMd` reads `templates/agents-entry.md` from the content tree just reconciled (via #4706 `readAgentsTemplateFromContentTree` / `agentsRefreshPlanWithInstalledTemplate`) and stamps `sha=` from that tree's version — not bare `frameworkRoot: deftDir` through `contentRoot()` prefer-package. Divergent project `@deftai/directive-content` gets companion `npm ci` disclosure for remaining prefer-package readers; not an alternate first-ship fix. Does not recut global prefer-package (#4706 deferred). Tracking #5013.

- **Consumer deposit now includes the subagent heartbeat contract (#4891).** MUST cites resolve to `.deft/core/docs/subagent-heartbeat.md` via the content/docs flatten. Closes #4891.

- **Unmarked finalize no longer pairs an origin with an unrelated merged PR (#5122).** Tracking unmarked work stays visible and non-blocking until a product PR is stamped (#4864). Duplicate refs to one origin stay unverified; distinct repository-and-number origins still refuse. Closes #5122.

- **Closeout no longer attests merge evidence minted only in memory (#5120).** `evaluateAcceptanceEvidenceGate` is read-only over persisted bytes. `scope:complete` stamps declared merge evidence on the persist path (even when later acceptance refuses) so later closeout, `verify:completed-tracked`, and orphan-active triage see the same file. After delivery ancestry already passed on that complete, the stamp reuses it and does not `git fetch` again. Closeout does not mint and does not `git fetch`. Closes #5120.

- **GHES host parsing keeps a non-default port (#5016).** HTTPS remotes such as `https://ghe.example:8443/org/repo` resolve to `ghe.example:8443` so credential lookup and `gh --hostname` use the same host:port.

- **update refuses GENERATION.json rewind against this-run delivery tip (#4120).** Invocation-owned fetch pin, `--no-replace-objects` token read, increment arms require proposed > tip, bind no longer mints, dest-plan/empty-plan cannot skip the gate. Merge-time `deft-core-guard` requires `head.generation` greater than `origin/$BASE_REF` when the token changes. Closes #4120.
- **Empty-directory `directive init` proceeds when git spawn ENOENTs (#4120).** A dest with no git directory is no-remotes, so the gate stamps or keeps prior instead of refusing `git binary not found`. Dest-plan still cannot skip the gate. Refs #4120.
- **Generation rewind residuals (#4120).** Ancestor `.git` is not remote-free on git ENOENT. Core-guard generation heredoc closer is at column 0; bootstrap requires generation >= 1. Init against a known delivery-tip token stamps tip+1. Fallback delivery identity plus empty ls-remote is unreadable, not absence. Live update reuses the this-run gate fetch. Refs #4120.
- **Cached generation stamp cannot rewind a newer local token (#4120).** `directive update` rechecks `.deft/GENERATION.json` before reusing a prior `decideGenerationStamp`. `stampLiveGeneration` never writes an older generation over a newer one. Init stamps the gate's proposed generation (tip+1 when a delivery tip exists). Refs #4120.
- **Update and init roll back payload when a generation recheck refuses after dest writes (#4120).** Recheck the local token before payload/VERSION swap. If a concurrent unreadable token still refuses after swap, restore the previous `.deft/core` (or remove a greenfield init deposit). Refs #4120.
- **Init unstages a refused generation-rewind deposit and keeps pre-existing staged installer edits (#4120).** When the post-write generation recheck refuses, rollback restores `.deft/core`, writes back index rows snapshotted before dest writes, and resets only paths this run staged. A consumer's pre-staged installer path stays staged. Refs #4120.
- **Init rollback preserves staged deletions and rename-from paths of installer files (#4120).** The pre-init snapshot records `git diff --cached` `D`/`R` sources that `ls-files --stage` omits. Refuse rollback force-removes those index paths instead of resetting them to HEAD. Refs #4120.
- **fix(release): suite-stamp / PASS_WITH_DEBT must cite tip-SHA GHA coverage-of-record; never cite check-run id as gha-run; prefer lane cite when aggregator lacks parseable actions/runs URL (Tracking #5026).**
- **SCM ready-cache binds host-store identity; shallow no longer claims authenticated (#5016).** A `gh auth switch` or hosts.yml credential change revalidates. Consumer agents-entry admits installation authentication when no user is required.

A relative path, the forbidden `.deft/one-pr-unit` path, a failed directory create, and an unreadable or malformed claims file are configuration failures, not a request to mint again. A directory with no claims file, including one this check just created, stays a missing grant. Tracking #4950.

The dest plan still runs before the Git gate so a dirty tree is still refused. Successful dry-run dest-plan JSON is unchanged. Tracking #4773.

A return visit with no Personal Depth field is asked once. Only one Personal `1`, `2`, or `3` is the track. Duplicate lines, an invalid value, and any line outside Personal are not the track. Strategy and coverage are not the track. An existing PROJECT-DEFINITION, including empty narratives, is not a missing-answers detector. Identity strings stay `project:write-narratives`. Tracking #4668.
- **Default doctor does not reprint a remembered dirty skip after `.deft/core` presence changes (#4886).** Skip runs only when the stored deposit bit matches live `classify().hasDeftCore`. An old state file without that field falls through once, and the completed probe persists live counts. `--full` stays the remaining-skip bypass. The dirty window stays for installed trees whose last probe already found live errors. Tracking #4886.
- **Init next step follows the current branch before the payload commit (#4665).** Next steps step 1 is only `git commit -m "chore(deft): update framework payload"` when the current branch is neither main nor master. Otherwise, including unborn main or master, it says to create a new feature branch first and then run that commit. It does not name `feat/first-project`. The stdout summary object names that commit command alone. Push, a pull request, and merge stay off those two surfaces. `success` stays the deposit result. Tracking #4665.
- **swarm:finalize-cohort finishes the brief it was given (#4937).** The closer passes the issue and the merged product pull request. An empty closing list uses that pull request's validated delivery snapshot as evidence for the issue. The lifecycle commit is cut from a checkout of origin/<deliveryBranch>, not the implement branch. A failed fast-forward does not leave the brief moved there. The command waits for the lifecycle pull request to merge and does not merge it. After that land it origin-closes with both numbers. When --base-branch differs from delivery, the land wait and the origin-close use the branch that the lifecycle pull request merges into. A successful return means the issue was closed. --no-open-pr reports the lifecycle commit succeeded and leaves the issue open. A failed worktree remove leaves the checkout registered and reports that failure. A null or non-object lifecycle pull-request status fails immediately and is not retried. Tracking #4937.
- **Matching-pin doctor signpost is a labeled migrate-only advisory (#4755).** The `canonical-vendored-npm-signpost` warning starts with `Signpost advisory:` and reuses the one-command migrate nudge. It does not append the global npm upgrade command. Matching-pin resolution stays proceed. The throttle closer keeps `(throttle-skipped full probe)`. Tracking #4755.

- **Parseable AcceptanceCriteria lines are the derived clauses when plan items have titles (#4867).** Item titles are not that clause set. Bare prose in that key still is not a clause, and Test or Verification without AcceptanceCriteria lines still yields to the item surface. Tracking #4867.
- **Rapid product-first check does not exit 0 when the acceptance walk reports zero verified clauses (#4866).** Unverifiable clauses still do not fail `verify:ac`. Rapid mode still runs only the product AC gate. Tracking #4866.
- **Windows `cmd.exe` spawn keeps a spaced project path, a spaced `deft.cmd`, and token `a&b` together (#4772).** Global engine invoke and the sibling `cmd.exe /d /s /c` sites use `windowsVerbatimArguments` plus the outer quotes `/s` strips. JSON env transport and `shell: false` stay. Vendored Node argv is unchanged. Tracking #4772.
- **First-run init success keeps what was created and one next step (#4656).** The init success path no longer prints the upgrade commit recipe or the fresh-init migrate nudge. The next-step list keeps only opening the AI coding assistant in the project directory. Tracking #4656.
- **Setup can store Phase 2 narratives while no scope xBRIEF is active (#4663).** `project:write-narratives` writes Overview, TechStack, Strategy, Quality, ProjectRules, and Branching into PROJECT-DEFINITION. The write is that command, not an agent patch. It does not set policy keys. Re-entry keeps those policy keys and values; JSON whitespace may change. Consumers must not patch that file. `agentsMdBudget.absoluteMaxBytes` 19200→19314. Policy changes stay on `policy:enforce-branches` and `policy:allow-direct-commits`. An agent patch of that file stays denied. Tracking #4663.

Existing directories stay off `artifact_path`. Stamp and the clause walk still require a contained regular file. Tracking #4840.
- **#4008 bind reuses stamp realpath containment for existing matchAny files (#4840).** An in-repo symlink to an external regular file is not bindable. Missing in-scope files still bind; existing in-scope regular files still bind. Glob-shaped pointers and directories stay refused. Tracking #4840.

- **#4008 bind and the clause walk accept a matchAny file under glob file_scope (#4840).** Glob-shaped stored paths and declared-member glob text hits stay refused. `inspectActiveScope` reports a structured zero-eligible-blocked reason; the write-fence suffix names `scope:unblock` or `scope:stamp-evidence`. Evidence `pointer` is fenced in detail and completion listings. Tracking #4840.

After first relieves, unresolved-pain-audit is a pain-audit brief while Dual-stop remains, not operator next-envelope. Dual-stop raise stays a raise. Do not recut evaluateHandoffPrint.
- **Unchanged landed completed filenames no longer fail vbrief:validate (#4844).** A completed name that already landed stays valid. A basename this change adds or renames, including one with dots, uppercase, or an apostrophe, stays a hard filename error. The printed remedy names that scope and does not say to edit JSON or rename landed records.
- **Opting out of host hooks can clear a current-session hook refusal after the running host reloads or relaunches (#4854).**

The filename includes a project key so two projects do not share one path. A same-second exclusive create that returns EXISTS retries another name and still stamps. - **plan-sequence:current and verify:plan-sequence name a missing sequence_kind (#4843).** A present `.deft/plan-sequence.json` whose `sequence_kind` is not a string is not an authorized sequence. Both verbs name that file and field, and they include the terminal-lifecycle fact when the one pending current entry's origin is already in `completed/` or `cancelled/`. That fact is not "every entry is already completed". `plan-sequence:set` and `createPlanSequence` are unchanged. Tracking #4843.
- **BestiMax legacy reserved-prefix subtypes warn instead of fail-closed (#4846).** `prerequisite`, `related-pr`, `source`, `runbook`, `prior-art`, `peer`, `upstream`, `origin`, and `related-scope` join the existing Class B set under `x-vbrief/` and `x-xbrief/`. They stay unrecognized and `nearestCanonical` stays null. Default `xbrief:validate` exits 0; `--warnings-as-errors` stays 1. `validateVbriefSchema` stays fatal-only. - **swarm:finalize-cohort --dry-run no longer reports FINALIZE CLEAN when #3240 evidence is missing (#4839).** An active story or an already-active parent clones the plan, persists clause-keyed items on the clone, then runs the acceptance-evidence gate. A failed gate is action failed, ok false, and the gate message, and the path stays out of settled. A passing gate still records would-complete. Derivation stays on pending. Dry-run does not write the brief or call runTransition. Tracking #4839.
- **verify:forward-coverage counts .js sources (#4819).** `.js` joins the correspondence triple: `SOURCE_EXTENSIONS`, `isTestFile`, and `expectedTestBasenames` (`.test.js` / `.spec.js` from the existing test-boundary names). Staged `src/app.js` plus `src/untested.js` fails; colocated `.test.js` / `.spec.js` passes. `.mjs` / `.cjs` / `.jsx` stay out. Tracking #4819.
- **Consumer baselines ignore `.deft-scratch/` (#4841).** Init, update, and the installer append the directory rule, same shape as `.claude/worktrees/`. An already-indexed path stays until `git rm --cached`. `temp/` stays off the baseline. Tracking #4841.
- **scope:complete PlanItem ids match the 0.8 dotted-segment pattern (#4707).** Persist writes `clause.N`. Lookup dual-reads leftover `clause:N`. Rewrite-only leftover `clause:N` → `clause.N` persists before the acceptance evidence gate even when no new items are added. `xbrief:validate` fails closed on a non-conformant string `id`. Same-PR rewrite of synthesis `clause:N` ids. Integer ids and warn-first stay leftover. Tracking #4707.
- **Spec-path harvest no longer copies the refused GitHub body into Overview (#4524).** `buildIssueVbrief` assigns Overview from harvest remainder when `specPathHarvest` is present, and persists the body under `plan.metadata.issueBody`. Body-is-normative ingest still copies the body. Cache `content.md` is an explicit non-goal. Do not grow `scan()` as an instruction-shaped detector. Tracking #4524.
- **N=3 Dual-stop leftover-pain parent path admits the reserved pain-audit slot (#4522).** Parent-facing Dual-stop is numbered remaining OR `inCapWithoutRaise`. leftover-pain `evaluateDualStopParentPath` calls existing `evaluateDualStopReservedSlot`. Dual-stop fourth-post prose no longer says a fourth post always needs a raise. Reserved-slot use comes from exported `criticEnvelopes` after the earliest asserted-coverage successor lean. A later Recut-supersedes lean does not reset that count. The walk stops at the current arc's `design-critique: cancelled` boundary, so a prior cancelled arc cannot consume the slot. Live parent turns stay unenforced. Closes #4522.

- **verify:orphan-active fail-closes dropped refs instead of skipping them as noOrigin (#4697).** Unknown reserved spellings (`pull-request` and the next unknown) and uncollected `github-issue`/`github-pr` entries exit 1 with a collectable-origin remedy. Title-only setup-created and known non-GitHub types stay the Origins line. Malformed PR-only stays on the unscoped scan. Does not recut `collectGithubRefs` or #4426. Refs #4697.
- **design-critique ingest-ready remaining-set refuses unless live-thread evaluateCompletedArcRecord is complete (#4700).** Shared proof on the chip verb and ScmLabelClient.apply exclusive fold. Comments present is not complete. Proof-fail is blocking, not CHIP_APPLY_MISS. mechanism-shaped and in-progress stay labels-only. Path-1 stays on evaluateAutoStampPath1Write. Refs #4700.
- **Throttle-skip after a warning-only doctor run is not billed as clean (#4673).** The skip line uses persisted lastFindingCount; lastErrorCount 0 with findings >= 1 does not print clean. isDirty stays lastErrorCount > 0. README diagnosis rows and diagnosis front doors name `--full`. Ritual session-start `deft doctor` stays the cost skip. Missing `.deft/core` skip invalidation stays on #4679. Refs #4673.
- **Consumer mutation session:start no longer fail-closes on missing uv (#4672).** Unflagged verify:tools uses the toolchain:check consumer set (git, gh). uv and python stay maintainer-only with --include-task. Does not widen requirements xbrief/active. Does not skip mutation session:start. Refs #4672.
- **Missing design-critique spend token asks before Stop 1 (#4705).** `parseOperatorSpend` resolves `n=1` / `n=3` / `n>=3` on the operator chat utterance; decimal continuations (`n=1.5`) ask; yolo is not spend; bare panel and colliding classes ask. `evaluateSpendRecord` refuses silent N=1. Stop 2 and the brief no longer display selected N=1. Leaves #3846 open. Refs #3657, #4027, #4072.
- **Unknown reserved x-xbrief/ and x-vbrief/ subtypes are reported (#4698).** `x-xbrief/pull-request` is no longer ignore-by-default: `validateVbriefSchema` (task check) and `collectGithubRefs` report it. Canonical `github-pr` still matches. Engine-written `closes` / `current-shape` / `web-page` / `github-comment` / related-* stay valid. A mixed `github-issue` plus `pull-request` plan still reports the unknown reserved subtype. Does not enforce `KNOWN_REFERENCE_TYPES` as the closed set, close every `x-*` namespace, recut URI-shape fallback, or wire orphan-active `evaluate.ts` (companion #4697). Refs #4698.
- **Hook diagnosis still names pin/engine skew when agent_hooks fails, and fail-closed nextAction names DEFT_ACCEPT_ENGINE_SKEW without claiming proceed (#4692).** A true valid() fail still reports as that fail. Hook-drift recovery is not the skew fix. Literal <gate> is not runnable argv. Pin reconstitution remains #4710. Refs #4692.

- **Doctor Next command after content is already at engine is pin follow-through, not another update (#4718).** Within-window engine>pin with content>=engine is mode align-pin. Next command is renderProjectInstall at the engine spec (pnpm add -D / npm install --save-dev). Null content and content-behind-pin still recommend update. Pin write inside update stays #4710. Refs #4718.

> Leftover-land recovery, design-critique panel ceiling, occupancy persist-and-bind, one-PR-unit node-id bind, docs-impact PR-base, leftover ingest/complete.

- Added — Prefer-A Recut-2 for `feedback:file`: complete open inventory dedup, closed retained-count window (500) with disposition tokens, open-match evidence comment (`commented-open-duplicate`), and `--on-closed=comment|create-anyway` without reopen. Refs #5099.

### Changed

- **Maintainer .gitignore un-ignores provenance under .deft/approved-scope and .deft/intent-constraint.** Local scratch and reconstituted .deft/core stay ignored. Not consumer CANONICAL_GITIGNORE_BASELINE. Mint records show in git status without -f.
- **Solo leftover-land recovery names the post-merge land sequence (#4421).** Sanctioned close-out is unreachable from the solo path, not unsatisfiable. After merge: scope:complete, git add of that verb's diff, leftover-land lifecycle PR. Do not Edit/Write completed/ or mint a completing status. Greptile: active/ on a product PR is correct; completed/ before merge stays a defect; leftover-land after merge is sanctioned. Org dashboard rules cannot be overridden by rules.md. Closes #4421.
- **Design-critique panel ceiling (#4435).** Multi-critic rounds now include the panel deposit in the round-1 input ceiling. Closes #4435.

### Fixed

- **Pain-audit English headings are not targeting (#4648).** Dispatch fills `audit-targets:` with marker ids or none. Path-1 auto-stamp waits until that field is present. Closes #4648.
- **docs-impact comparison base is PR base.ref or explicit --base-ref, not origin/master (#4675).** Merge-base, name-status range, and snapshot showBase share one resolved base. --pr reads base.ref from the same REST pull GET. --body-file requires --base-ref, threaded through verifyDocsImpactBodyFile, leftover-complete, and finalize-cohort as the same ref as gh pr create --base. Missing or unresolvable intended base is EXIT_CONFIG. Does not reuse origin-default resolvers or default to HEAD. Does not recut #4356 or #4293. Closes #4675.
- **Session, occupancy, and swarm unit tests isolate declared-host identity (#4636).** Tests that are not host detection inject a constructed env bag or an explicit session id so ambient Codex markers cannot refuse-mint. Codex-positive refuse-mint covers CODEX_CI. Does not weaken declared-host detection or add CODEX_CI to the TypeScript lane poison list. Closes #4636.
- **One-PR-unit required check persists and binds by PR node id (#4635).** Mint writes the Directive GitHub App private transactional store a later process can read. A non-empty DEFT_ONE_PR_UNIT_APP does not select InProcessAppStore. Until that store is configured, the required check names a deployment/configuration failure, not mint remediation. Live checks find reserved mint output, exact-set match, bind the immutable PR node id, then enforce with that node id. Failures never report unknown/unknown for a live PR. Closes #4635.
- **Occupancy claim is instruction-only for CLI complete and check (#4625).** Occupancy stays coordination, not a #3334/#3396 fail-closed oracle on gated verbs. Session:start / ritual does not bind CLI scope:complete and check. Occupancy refuse is not written into complete without recutting the occupancyLive always-true stub. Write-gate fail-open leftover stays #3729. Auto-claim is not #3805 complete-verb recovery; later auto-claim is #3729 write-path third option (host-published owner, not a CLI mint). Dest-without-occupy exceptions: process_only, leftover complete, finalize-cohort. Sibling #4624 stays a different slice. Closes #4625.
- **verify:ac FromPath write and lookup share resolveScopeIdForAcReuse (#4631).** Id-less walks synthesize the collision-aware oracle path instead of missing "no scope id" or banking a basename stem. Outside-root briefs keep the relative (including ..) path so same-filename briefs do not share a bank. Empty-pass stays unbankable. #3558 bank-on-verified-pass remains. Closes #4631.
- **Budget-valued `total_tool_turns` is not `harness_actual`, and a cap is unevaluable for the #3352 trigger (#4626).** `resolveSessionToolTurnDenominator` labels TOTAL that equals planned / `hostMaxTurns` as `host_planned`. `computeRitualGateShare` pairs each selected denominator with the source on that line and does not graduate or decline on a cap. `evaluateLaterGraduationTrigger` does not reclassify a persisted `harness_actual` from the reporter process env. No third env var and no #3928 recut. Closes #4626.
- **Setup-minted occupancy skip-claim (#4624).** A process that cannot present the later hook owner must not mutation-claim this tree (`session:start --read-only` or skip mutation `session:start`). `--session-id` stays the bind when that process is the later presenter. Heartbeat on long verbs is not a remedy. A live minted no-write lease is not residue and is not auto-released. No new occupancy identity. Sibling #4625 stays a different slice. Closes #4624.
- **Refuse --allow-close N while issue N still has a running xbrief/active brief, and halt pr:wait-mergeable-and-merge on a current-HEAD Greptile NEW_P0_P1 (#4628).** --allow-close stays the #3015 intent-mode allowlist; the refuse prints Refs/Tracking and names the brief path. Live --pr intent skip is unchanged. The waiter maps SHA-matched pr:watch hasBlocking in-process (named outcome, exit 1, one probe) and does not wait out --cap-minutes. Sub-floor confidence without P1 still waits. Other merge routes stay #3875. Closes #4628.
- **Launch occupancy records no longer silently swap session or roster, and swarmLaunch calls verifyPlanTarget (#4595).** persistLaunchOccupancyRecord creates, or replaces only when the live lease and roster match. occupancyCohortKey includes story ids so --group is not one roster file for disjoint waves. Lookup corroborates live occupant identity. A leftover roster with a new live occupant is retracted then created only when the record matches the live session. failAfterClaim retracts only a record created by this launch. Unnamed swarm-cohort fail-closes on any verifyPlanTarget rejection unless C1 allocation-plan id plus batching rationale are present. CLI verify:plan-sequence stays skipped-ok when no sequence file. Closes #4595.
- **scope:complete refuses unbound acceptance clauses (#4385).** Persist clause-keyed pending items at complete even when the evidence gate then refuses. Keep #3826 walk. scope:status listing emits counts and ids; clause/task text is fenced. Pending change-task ledger is leftover (prefer derive-status; #4426 owns issue-less origin). Refuse persist does not write a complete lifecycleWrite stamp. Terminal clause-keyed rows without evidence or disposition still refuse. Closes #4385.
- **verify:session-ritual parse error on --session-id names the drop-flag retry (#4576).** Unrecognized --session-id / --session-id= still exits 2. Stderr appends a suffix to drop the flag and retry deft verify:session-ritual -- --tier=gated. Other unknown flags stay generic. Occupancy bind stays on session:start / session:ready. Closes #4576.
- **Clean-tree deft update names the index (#4562).** printUpdateComplete prints a Staged row from post-add cached names. Ignored deposit paths are filtered from git add so a born-ignored .deft/core/ does not invert commit guidance. Partial git add no longer prints as a complete index; remaining tracked paths stay in the guidance. Does not reverse #4158. Pre-staged-commit cross-session index write stays leftover. Closes #4562.
- **install-upgrade #2064 parity test uses the win32 240s coverage floor (#4564).** The per-test override was 20s, which undercuts vitest.config.ts win32 testTimeout 240_000 under vitest --coverage. Win32 arm is 240_000; non-win32 stays 20_000. Do not skip under coverage. Does not recut #2064 product parity. Closes #4564.
- **README and docs-site name that agents Lie, Cheat, and Steal (#4623).** After the cold-start block, the early What it is explanation expands LCS on first use and says Directive helps prevent that. Occupancy steal is not that slogan. Closes #4623.
- **At-scale triage bootstrap 60-write cases use the per-it timeout ternary (#4638).** Backlog scale, progress lines, and fetch_timeout_s=0 are 15s on Linux and keep the 240s win32 cap. Does not raise unit or root testTimeout or add spawnHeavyGlobs. Closes #4638.
- **Quoted-literal and Emacs-concat harvest no longer fail open past 512 bytes (#4637).** Closing-delimiter and closing-paren match-length caps are gone on those accepted sinks. Ordinary /tmp stays unclassifiable. Does not recut #3728/#3804. Closes #4637.
- **Issue ingest no longer copies comment bodies into Overview (#4434).** Thread comments persist under plan.metadata.issueCommentThread. The composer banner that treated comments as superseding dispatch input is retracted. Live REST #2143 stays. Class 2 SoT remains content/meta/security.md. Closes #4434.
- **Active-UAT `uat-suspend` is reachable from a real operator console (#4632).** `gateConfirm()` skips `refuseMintWhileUatActive` only for `uat-suspend` and still runs `refuseNonInteractiveMint`. Grant, uat-start, and revoke stay mint-refused while UAT is active. Missing-op and expired-grant denials name human-presence `authz:uat-suspend`, not remint. Suspend reuses the typed phrase `mint`. Direct `suspendUatLease` stays ungated (#4233). Closes #4632.

- **Intent-constraint mint selection and site identity (#4541).** Multiple merge-base mints without `--plan-id` or dest unique pin fail closed; do not take record `[0]`. Throw/reject/abort ids use compact statement text, not source offsets. Closes #4541.
- **Requirements posture transport, nested instruction deny, and symlink class (#4444).** `session:start --posture=requirements` writes gitignored `.deft/session-posture.json` so PreToolUse sees the trusted producer when hook env cannot inherit DEFT_SESSION_POSTURE. Nested AGENTS.md/main.md/SKILL.md deny. In-tree symlink components on docs/specs paths refuse write-requirements-ready. Persisted posture is bound to the occupancy owner. Read-only start does not delete another occupant file. Mutation start (cold and re-arm) clears that file only after mutation ritual is ready (exit 0). A failed overlay clear refuses ready. Persist-fail on a new requirements claim releases the lease. Occupancy engine stays on #4445. Refs #4444.

- **Consumer scope-provenance docs and the dispatch preamble use `deft <verb>` (#4447).** Include-only fallback is `task deft:<verb>`. Frozen hop-1 stays `task -t <v0.59.0 Taskfile> migrate:vbrief`. ### Fixed

- **UAT Shell dest-flag dest-not-last empty-ops emit grant-immune `unknown` (#4204 / #4218 / #4161 / #3918 / #3849).** Dest-flag operands (`-oN`, `-w`, `--result-file` / `-r`, `--compile`, `-output` / `--out-file`, `-jobname=` / `--jobname`, `restic restore --target` with cargo `--target` skipped, including `timeout`/`ionice` wrappers) and `of=` / `-out:` / `json:` dests classify `unknown` when the dest is payload-protected and not last-positional. Named bins stay corpus. Last-positional dest-of-write and dest-last `-o` settings stay. `grep -w`, `cargo --target`, `/tmp` dests, and proven reads stay unclassifiable. `--python_out` is not a dest-flag (#3918). Quoted `bash`/`sh`/`zsh -c` dest-of-write is dest-visible. Closes #4204, #4218, #4161, #3918, #3849.

- **Land `process_only` on Grok PreToolUse `tool_input` for general-purpose plus dest cwd (#4315).** Adapter copies the host-visible flag from Grok stdin (`toolInput` / `processOnly` / top-level) onto canonical `tool_input`. That stdin shape is `spawn-process-only-ready` (no dest occupancy, no leftover `file_scope`) at zero, one, or many leftover eligible briefs. Unmarked dest-cwd general-purpose stays #2885 or implement-class dest-lock. Implement-class never sets the flag. Advertised schema is a separate upstream ask. CLI last-resort after any native outcome that is not skip-class. Does not re-open #4296 or classify `grok --cwd` (#4219). Closes #4315.

- **Dest-bearing MCP/proxy writes, interpreter-payload dests, and migrate header in-tree symlinks (#3593).** `CallMcpTool` / `use_tool` unwrap inner names; dest-bearing write-shaped MCP shares `inspectMutationGates` with Write. Deposited `MCP_HOOK_MATCHER` includes the wrapper spellings so hosts invoke unwrap. `-e`/`-c`/`eval` quoted write payloads (including `q{}` / `%q{}` brace literals) and `jar cf` / compact `cfm`/`cmf`/`cfe` / `jar --create|--update --file=DEST` emit grant-immune `unknown` with dest bound to `f` letter order. `patchAgentsMdHeader` refuses in-tree destination symlinks on both branches. Does not grow settings/bin catalogs or fail-closed MCP reads. Closes #3593.
- **Unify write containment and migrate four #3953 sinks.** `assertWriteTargetSafe` now matches `assertDestinationNotSymlink` (full path-component walk). `containedWrite` refuses in-tree parent-directory symlinks. `changelog-cli`, `renderSpec`, `renderPrd`, and `exportSpec` write through `containedWrite` with a named root. Assist-scratch classification refuses in-tree leaf and parent symlinks before `write-assist-scratch-ready`; the hook check/use race is a named residual. The four modules leave `CONTAINED_WRITES_ALLOWLIST`. Does not close #3764 finding 4 or #3593 finding 5. UAT classifier work closed on #4199. Closes #3953.
- **Occupancy identity denials name `hook --host <flag>` so the next repro can observe the child argv (#4409).** Recut: CLAUDE_* is not the owner producer; DEFT_SESSION_ID is not a blanket override of a derived host owner; deposit reconstitution stays on #4443; `session:ready` preserves presented identity and does not infer ownership from occupancy.json. Closes #4409.
- **Occupancy deny and close-out copy no longer print the steal argv to the refused party (#4410).** Isolation, read-only, occupant grant, and occupant release remain. `--confirm` stays a flag, not a human gate. No recency guard. #4409 stays separate. Closes #4410.
- **SessionStart empty-active is a normal skip, occupancy `--help` names `deft help`, and gated ritual recovery is not doubled (#4411).** No-active xBRIEF returns 0 with no `vbrief` stderr. Occupancy-namespace unrecognized arguments name `deft help` / `deft commands`. Gated-step verify no longer appends Recovery inside the step message. Does not recut grok models auth copy. Closes #4411.
- **SLizard merge gate parses emphasized check-run summaries and does not block on zero findings (#4387).** `parseSlizardCheckRunSummary` in greptile-detector.ts line-anchors Decision, Merge impact, Findings, and Severity counts after stripping markdown emphasis. Finding-count lands with that parse: `request_changes`, `merge_impact=blocking`, and `conclusion=failure` block only when the same check-run summary is not zero-finding. Crash/timeout with no parseable zero-finding verdict still block. Captured live `output.summary` from `deftai/bs-deepwordle#4` SHA `a8a20f3` (check-run 103182122466) is the fixture; that summary has no `slizard:verdict` HTML comment (the comment is on the review body). Does not fetch PR reviews. Closes #4387.
- **Managed AGENTS.md recovery is the #4090 ladder, not dangling payload or README pointers (#4430).** `agents-entry.md` fallback and cold-start clause, plus `main.md` / `SKILL.md` preambles, recover doctor-first then `npm i -g @deftai/directive@<pin>` (read pin from committed package.json). Named recovery targets must resolve on a greenfield clone and when the payload is committed. Separate carrier list (`templates/agents-entry.md`); CANONICAL_PATHS unchanged. Option A is an absence-triggered global install from a consumer-unrepairable prompt, not strictly safer than a rewritten committed block. Does not deposit README or add a `.deft/core/` spelling denylist. Closes #4430.
- **Occupancy grant remediation interpolates owner and role; activate-from-proposed prints promote then activate (#4412).** `session:ready` announces mint versus resolve. Claude Bash rewrite emission is measured; no second identity rewrite. Pin work stays on #4429. Closes #4412.
- **Completed-record Edit after complete names a recovery that can succeed (#4422).** Empty-active Write deny restates "no approved xBRIEF is available" in a one-scope repo, not a fake-scope prohibition. Terminal `scope:undo` of complete/fail points at Edit under `xbrief/completed/` or `git revert` of the complete commit, not a denied hand-edit. Completed-path writes reuse the proposed/ all-targets exemption plus authz, runtimeAuthority, and occupancy rechecks. Does not print `scope:undo` as the next rung. Closes #4422.
- **Lifecycle stamps keep envelope and plan clocks aligned and warn when updated predates created (#4423).** `stampExistingEnvelopes` now writes `plan.updated` with the envelope. `scope:undo` and `scope:demote` route through it. `validateAll` / `vbrief:validate` / `verify:vbrief-conformance` warn on reversed created/updated. Does not clamp `created`, does not add `--stamp-created`, and does not lint item `completed`. Closes #4423.
- **Greenfield `directive init` writes the canonical package.json pin before gitignoring `.deft/core/` (#4429).** Reuses `ensurePackageJsonPin`; pin write precedes the gitignore line so a throw cannot leave an unreconstitutable deposit. Headless already emitted the same pin. Missing-pin doctor note stays a proceed warning (error would retro-fail pre-pin consumers). JSON reformat of an existing `package.json` is accepted. Closes #4429.

- **UAT authz: repo-root evidence globs, write-shaped unlisted tools, dest-visible empty-ops (#4199).** Nested `**/evidence/**` is no longer grant-free. `EditNotebook` is a direct write; unlisted write-shaped names infer. Noclobber redirects and dest-visible empty-ops classify instead of fail-open. Closes #4199.
- **UAT Shell fail-closes unknown writes to four protected dests (#4188).** Unknown last-positional dest-of-write to `.deft/authz/**`, `.deft/approved-scope/**`, `.deft-directive-disable`, or `.no-deft-directive` UAT-denies. Proven reads stay allow, including `sort`/`sha256sum`/`awk` inspection; `sort`/`awk` `-o` and attached `-oFILE` stay dest-of-write. Closes #4188.
- **Payload-identity hosts no longer mint a UUID occupancy lease (#4431).** `session:start` / `session:ready` refuse to mint on a host with a declared identity contract. A print-only companion names the host-published owner when no hook is registered (`CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID` is not a `host-env` claim source). Non-inspectable lifecycle commands fail closed instead of allowing the mint, except when they already carry the matching --session-id. POSIX env-assignment prefixes (FOO=bar cmd) bind like the unprefixed command or fail closed on chains. Newline, single `&`, grouped `(cmd)` / `{ cmd; }`, and `then`/`do` control forms fail closed with a tokenizer hint (no regex). Argument-position `deft` is not an invocation. Quoted argument strings or comments are not invocations; quoted executable names remain invocations. Matching --session-id must sit on every lifecycle segment, not a sibling or a later foreign owner. Quote unwrap applies only at executable position. Denial text keys on recorded `identity_provenance`, not write history. Tracked `.claude/settings.json`; do not blanket-exclude `.claude/` in `.git/info/exclude`. Follow-ups: #4434 (ingest-republication), #4435 (design-critique contract). Closes #4431.
- **`deft update` refuses dirty or unreadable Git before dest writes (#4158).** Three-state porcelain probe (`git --no-optional-locks status --porcelain=v1 -z --untracked-files=all`). No-repo proceeds; repo-present-but-unreadable refuses; `--allow-dirty-no-stage` skips `git add` but not `core.hooksPath`. Dry-run and live share dest-plan membership and measured `dirty_tree`/`dirty_files` on sibling `error_code`. Does not overlay incoming trees (#4446), lease occupancy, or teach the ledger `$HOME`. Closes #4158.
- **agents:refresh stamps a resolvable framework identity instead of sha=unknown (#4246).** Writable AGENTS.md states (absent/missing/stale) on a non-git npm install use package.json version, then live GENERATION.json contentVersion, then the running core package version. Own-git-root still uses git short HEAD. Does not preserve a leftover checkout SHA, mint a second 12-hex, recut #3914/#4118 git-fatal silence, or recut commands.md. Closes #4246.
- **`verify:vbrief-conformance --staged` (and `--all`) run D7 filename checks before parse (#4245).** The installed pre-commit hook uses `--staged`, which previously scanned bare keys only, so a dotted-slug xBRIEF could commit and then redden `vbrief:validate` / `task check`. Reuses `validateFilename`; does not retarget the hook at `vbrief:validate` and does not weaken D7 for version dots. Closes #4245.

- **A labeled, fence, or prompt `task_statement` row can be promoted through the documented slots (#4238).** Capture identity is command+cwd+exit+source (not stdout), so documented slots coexist with the original capture-only row. Execution identity is command+cwd+exit and runs once; retained stdout expectations are checked after that run. Inline mentions stay #3721. Does not retag `source` to `explicit`. Closes #4238.

### Removed

Cached `runReleaseCheck` tees the suite, kills the tree at 20 minutes with exit 124 (`REAL_FAILURE`), and sets `DEFT_CHECK_MODE=full`. Worker load/exit failures notify the waiter instead of waiting out the backstop; in-memory capture is byte-capped. Fork (b): reporter stays text + text-summary. Dest+parent is not a share token: two sequential same-parent workers do not reuse one incarnation. Two parents and two presented incarnations still conflict. Occupied persist still rolls back this incarnation; EXISTS of a different incarnation does not delete the winner. Does not skip dest-lock for implement `general-purpose`. Closes #4254. Refs #4066, #4215.

Consumer empty-floor no longer prints `#3334` when clauses exist. Empty `clauses[]` still refuses. Absence wording such as `must be absent` still fails when the bound file is present and named as a path token, including short names and `./` prefixes. A short basename is the absence subject, including one intervening word (`the go file must not exist`), not later English prose. Other-subject negation is not an oracle for that path. Does not restore `verified.length > 0`. Does not recut #3497 or #4103. Companion #4239 stays open. Closes #4240.

Replacement sieve is #4071. Closes #4070.

- **Land completed-tracked artifact for #4070 (#3264 / #1358).** The #4070 xBRIEF stayed in active/ after squash of PR 4076 (f81e154d). Moved to xbrief/completed/ via scope:complete. Does not recut that issue. Refs #2321, #3476.
- **N≥3 design-critique panels now name claimed families at dispatch, and a Grok parent with `claude`/`codex` on PATH CLI-spawns those seats (#4067).** Same-family sibling sets cannot be leaned; recovery is re-seat, not Stop 5. Paste-ready is the fallback when a named family's CLI is absent. `evaluatePanelSeatComposition` refuses same-family panels and paste-ready-first when those CLIs resolve. A composition miss offers or files a prevention issue. Closes #4067. Refs #3962, #4035, #3850.

Extra properties on the evidence object fail `parseEvidence`. Disposition stays unknown. Closes #4059. Refs #3305, #3385.

The gate now loads `loadTestBoundaryPolicy` (the existing #3145 surface -- it does not add a second testRoots config) and searches colocated, `__tests__/`, and source-root-stripped paths under directory-shaped test roots. ## [0.109.1] - 2026-09-01

> Occupancy claim, release, grant, child close-out, and shell heartbeat now share one actor, so a session can keep and free its own worktree lease.

### Added
- Added — article-review Step 6.5 process-only critic pass before filing, with Step 5 mechanism inventory and Critic verdict section on filed issues. Refs #5694.
- Added — Prefer-A Recut-2 for `feedback:file`: complete open inventory dedup, closed retained-count window (500) with disposition tokens, open-match evidence comment (`commented-open-duplicate`), and `--on-closed=comment|create-anyway` without reopen. Refs #5099.
- Added — Helpers for reviewing a brief without creating a GitHub issue. These support file-based critic results, retained review records, and returning the accepted remedy to the same brief. Refs #5486.
### Changed
- **Closed 23 of 25 stale-issue audit candidates from #3915.** Evidence comments cite this tree, not pass-1 cites. Full verification for #973, #1283, #1422, and #2518. #513 closed as descoped (stub scanner is not a required master check and does not scan `.ts`). #602 and #630 stay open: no latent-vs-deterministic principle in `content/`, and `migrate:xbrief` still does not auto-render. #630's proposed brief is re-targeted; #760's proposed brief is cancelled as delivered. #2769 pass-4 retracts "product not yet shipped". Refs #3915.

### Fixed
- **The payload-root fallback for a write target with no Git toplevel is published as deliberate (#4013).** A write whose target lies outside every working tree — a path under the OS temp directory, a home file — is gated against the hook payload root's occupancy and ritual. That has been intended since #3794, but only the `unproven-identity` half of the split was written down, so the case read as a defect. `content/docs/hook-root-admission.md` now states the five outcomes of root admission, the reason this one is not a lease bug (the effective root also selects ritual, active scope, the write fence and assist-scratch; occupancy and ritual are cross-checked and the allow path re-stamps the lease; and `admitMutationTargetSet` demands one unique root, so a member contributing none has no combining rule), a gate-by-gate disposition for such a target, and the three-surface matrix — a bare direct-write name consults root admission, a generic server-prefixed MCP name never reaches it, and recognized Shell writes to outside destinations are excluded by #3987's classifier. Discoverable from `commands.md` § Session routing, `contracts/path-write-fence.md`, and `docs/host-surface-assumptions.md`. Seven characterization tests lock the behaviour; the `foreign-repository`, `unproven-identity` and `worktree-span` refusals are untouched. This publishes existing behaviour and changes none of it — the two narrowing remedies the issue proposed were refused as filed. Relative-target canonicalization is recorded as a known limitation and split to #4023. Closes #4013. Refs #3794, #3987.
- **The occupancy lease no longer starves while a session works through the shell, and every supported host's tool surface is audited (#3987).** Matcher coverage (#3990) closed the reissue bypass; the lease still renewed only on a gated write, and almost no real shell traffic is eligible for one — so an owner could commit and push all session while its own lease expired under a peer. A matched hook call now renews the lease of the tree it fires for, bounded to a host-authoritative owner, owner-only, without recording a product write, and without moving the 12-hour absolute lease cap. `deft verify:hooks-installed --scope=agent` and `deft doctor` now fail closed when a supported host's known mutation tool names are missing from the deposited matchers, so a new host or a renamed tool cannot silently drop out of coverage. Grok's `monitor` shell tool is now covered. Per-host coverage, the two Grok tools deliberately left uncovered, and the hosts whose spellings are unverified are recorded in `content/docs/host-tool-surface-audit.md`. Closes #3987. Refs #3990, #3599, #3873.
- **Mint-path session fixtures isolate from ambient `DEFT_SESSION_ID` (#3877).** The two mint-proof tests pass an empty env bag so a worker-shell export cannot override the minted id. Env-over-mint remains product law. Occupancy identity on a host with no session derivation is the hook process environment or `--session-id`, never a shell export. Closes #3877. Refs #3873.

- **A dispatched child that claims a worktree lease is released when its terminal heartbeat fires (#3999).** At dispatch the parent records the child's occupancy owner and the exact worktree root under `.deft/child-occupancy/` (lease-gated; not `.deft-scratch`). The orchestration monitor already detects `phase: terminal`; that transition now compare-and-releases under the occupancy lock only when the recorded child still owns the recorded tree. A successor owner is left alone. On `host-env` hosts this is the missing lifecycle event; on `payload` hosts parent and child share one id, so the same transition is a no-op — auto-releasing would drop a live parent lease mid-flight. Swarm close-out still releases only the launcher's occupancy_session_id. Out of scope: the 20-minute TTL, #3987, #3873, actor-resolution (#3954), and payload-root fallback (#4013). Closes #3999.

- **The verified-claims table refusal now names the missing heading, and the contract publishes that heading rule with the citation form it binds on (#3942).** `resolveCitedTable` merged two states into one `missing-table-cite` reason and one detail: a typed `verified-claims table <id>` citation naming an id that is not a comment on the thread, and one naming a comment that fails the shape predicate. Only the second is fixed by adding the heading, and the shared message asserted the first in both, so an author whose table was on the thread read a true citation being called false. Measured at `764f63a6`, the two details were identical modulo the id. An absent id keeps `missing-table-cite`; a cited on-thread comment carrying no heading now returns `unshaped-table-cite` and names the heading as the remedy, which is conformance to the diagnostics rule already in the contract rather than a second rule. `content/contracts/design-critique.md` publishes the heading requirement together with the condition that makes it operative -- it decides a verdict only under a typed claim -- records that the untyped path completes with a null table id so the published rule does not outrun the evaluator, cross-references `### Reserved line-starts` where the same token appears only as a prohibition, re-measures that matrix cell at `764f63a6` after #3932 and #3929 landed, and publishes the closed six-reason vocabulary that the content-contract suite now derives from the source union, so an unpublished reason fails closed. Does not narrow the citation contract to require a typed table claim, and does not change the untyped path: the seven live arc tables (5458204775, 5458431222, 5466045455, 5466061856, 5466142398, 5466430284, 5466455972) resolve identically before and after. Closes #3942. Refs #3932, #3929, #3831.

- **A session can now release the lease it just claimed, and a grant can no longer name a child that cannot exist (#3954).** Claim, release, heartbeat and grant/revoke resolved the acting session by three different rules, so on a host that publishes its own owner a session claimed under one identity and was then refused by its own lease, with a printed recovery only the occupant could run and the occupant unable to run it. The four surfaces now share one lookup order - explicit `--session-id`, then `DEFT_SESSION_ID`, then the host-published owner - and each keeps its own terminal: claim mints, because claiming establishes an identity; release, heartbeat and grant prove one, so they resolve to empty and keep the "presented no session identity" diagnosis a shared mint would have replaced with a plausible id no hook will ever present. When the ambient id and the host owner disagree the documented order still stands, and the refusal now names both. `occupancy:grant` joins the lifecycle identity transport, so the one verb the occupant must run can be told who the occupant is, and it validates the child: a value under the reserved `host:` prefix must be a well-formed canonical owner, and one that re-prefixes the owner's own payload under a second provider is refused as the self-grant it is - four malformed children were granted and then admitted as `member` before. A refused claim now names the identity it presented, and a granted child reads that claim is owner-only instead of being offered the grant it already holds. Anonymous release of the recorded occupant stays refused: possession of the lease path is not authority to delete a live lease. Occupancy CLI tests scrub the whole host-published environment, so the suite is hermetic on the host class the fix is for. Does not close #3873: the write gate runs in the hook sibling process, and nothing in this tree can put the host variable there. Closes #3954. Refs #3873, #3999, #3755, #3611, #3156.
